title: The Stone Game
prompt:
**Tình huống.** n ≤ 100000 piles of stones; two players alternate removing any positive number of stones from one pile; the player taking the last stone wins. Both play optimally. Who wins?

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Simulate the game with BFS over pile states

**B)** XOR of all pile sizes: first player wins iff nonzero

**C)** Sort piles and greedy the largest

**D)** Dijkstra on the state graph

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: This is exactly Nim: a position is losing iff the XOR of pile sizes is 0. Simulation of the full state space is exponential.
